typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		PRODUCT_FAMILY as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(Load_Date = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY as string,
		Load_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Trade_ID as integer,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PRODUCT_TYPE,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		Load_Date,
		Trade_ID = TRADE_ID,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
